name: Sands China Ltd.
summary: Sands China Ltd. is an investment holding company, a subsidiary of Las Vegas Sands Corp., that develops, owns and manages integrated resorts and casinos in Macao. Based in Taipa since its 2009 start, it operates The Venetian, The Londoner, The Parisian, The Plaza and The Sands Macao, plus the Cotai Expo, Cotai Arena and a ferry service. Its resorts combine hotels, restaurants, retail, convention space and theaters.
